access_token_seconds.description: How long each access token it obtains lives, in seconds (AI-38).

audience.description: The audience to ask the OAuth server for: its access tokens are accepted by the API for this audience only.

class.description: Its client class (AI-34): agent until the Owner reclasses it as integration with a second approver. An agent only reads and proposes.

client_id.description: The OAuth client ID: the client_id of its token requests (client_credentials grant).

client_secret.description: The secret that, with the client_id, obtains access tokens. Shown once and never again: Fyniq does not keep it and the OAuth server keeps only its hash. Store it as you would a password.

expires_at.description: When it stops: within 90 days of its creation.

networks.description: The networks it may call from, as CIDR prefixes; none: anywhere.

items.description: A network, as a CIDR prefix.

owner_id.description: The member it acts for: it never does more than this member may do now.

reads_per_minute.description: Its own limit of reads a minute; none: the platform's 600.

scopes.description: Its narrow scopes: fyniq.read.<area> views an area, fyniq.write.<area> also prepares and posts in it once it is an integration. No scope approves or releases.

items.description: A narrow scope: fyniq.read.<area> or fyniq.write.<area>.

status.description: live until it expires or is revoked.

writes_per_minute.description: Its own limit of writes a minute; none: the platform's 120.
